label: Wikidata
agentGuide: No key. Find an entity: GET /w/api.php?action=wbsearchentities&search=<name>&language=fr&format=json gives ids (Q90 = Paris). Read it: GET /wiki/Special:EntityData/Q90.json (labels, descriptions, claims; property ids like P1082 = population, P625 = coordinates). Several at once: GET /w/api.php?action=wbgetentities&ids=Q90|Q142&props=labels|claims&languages=fr&format=json. Questions over many items go to SPARQL: GET https://query.wikidata.org/sparql?format=json&query=<URL-encoded SPARQL>; keep queries small and add LIMIT. Read-only.
